notes.title: Launch Update - Midnight Release
notes.notes:
Great News everyone! Stream Runners: Heroes will be available for purchase tonight at midnight!

Thank you all so much for your patience, your support, and being all around awesome! It has been a lot of hard work to release this game. We are only two developers, an artist and a programmer, and with dedication and perseverance it was truly a pleasure to develop this game for our Twitch community. 

It all started when we wanted to give our chat something fun to play while we worked on artwork and development for our other indie game titles. Stream Runners evolved through the participation of our community, who offered their ideas for characters, enemies, themes, and eventually their suggestions for settings and options that could allow other streamers to use the game for all kinds of different things. 

We took all these ideas and input into our mixing pot of expertise and crafted a fun experience for Twitch streamers and their communities, big or small. Stream Runners is everything we hoped it would be, and we truly hope that you enjoy the game with your Twitch communities, like we do with ours.

Enjoy Stream Runners: Heroes, and you can bet Game Grotto will be live on Twitch making more indie games, so come stop by sometime and meet the developers and their community behind this little game for streamers.

Don and Meg, Game Grotto Softworks.
